findings.rationale: Accepted: the composeDenyList option is removed — review-packet.js is byte-identical, composition lives in review.js.

Accepted: one grammar owner (normalizeDenyList); the schema declares type only, no pattern; the shell regex is a projection proven by an oracle parity case in resolve-review-loop.test.sh (shell accept/reject == normalizeDenyList accept/throw over an inline table incl. whitespace/quote/backslash probes, both directions) — no copied table, drift fails the suite not a dispatch.

Accepted: reviewPacketIdentity validates every element through normalizeDenyList and blocks at prepare_review with "packet deny extra invalid pattern:

" (same message class as the resolver); review.js passes the raw composed list to the builder which normalizes — no uncaught throw path.

Refuted with evidence, folded as §0 fact: no consumer recomputes packet_hash or assumes the default list — review.js carries the string (:247,:327), autopilot-engine shape-checks/copies/compares seats (:61-63,:5100,:5135-5137,:5232-5243), campaign-composition validates 64-hex and applies mixed/mismatch across seats (:417-432), campaign-intake never reads it, verifyTreeIntegrity is test-only. A widened list changes every seat of a panel equally; §6 records it.
Accepted: composeDenyList removed; the codex mirror has platforms/codex/plugin/src/runners/review-packet.js at base so the mirrored import resolves — stated in §2.

Accepted: §4.1 now names the base record (base-suites-6a414c3c.txt, detached, sequential) and states that sync-codex-plugin-skills.sh --check diffs every mirror root (bin src schemas references scripts project-config-template …), covering all seven pairs.

Accepted: split on commas only with trim; per-element character allowlist [A-Za-z0-9._*/-] (no whitespace/quotes/backslash) so internal whitespace is refused not split, and JSON emission is safe by construction.
